title: 'Trump does not speak of freedom but fundamentally of oil,' Venezuelan opponent Arria says
summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, veteran Venezuelan opposition figure Diego Arria criticised US President Donald Trump's approach following the capture of President Nicolas Maduro by US special forces on January 3.
